text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room before the spring
Tenno Sho,
Ines Fujin psyches herself up
by slapping her own
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan and McQueen are running today
too, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ceding victory in the spring Tenno Sho
would be unthinkable for the prestigious
family. No doubt both Mejiro runners
and their supporters will be giving it
their all today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go out there and get a good
sense of
how those two run. Then I'll be
even more
prepared next time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: While you're at it, seize the vict...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I hope you're ready for the best
service
you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryan! Show the world just
how
incredible the Mejiro family is!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow. All they did was come out of the
tunnel,
and the audience is going wild...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! You're both truly wonderful! I do
hope
you'll do your very best to claim
victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can see the sparkle in their fans' eyes
from here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So Ryan and McQueen get showered
with all this
attention every time they
race...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I get it now. This is what's it like for
them—to live
with everyone's hopes on
their shoulders!
